Cupid Ltd Q2FY27 Results: Net profit up 133% YoY; FY27 guidance raised Net profit for Q2FY27 rose 133% YoY to ₹56.22 crore, while revenue from operations increased 122% YoY to ₹187.86 crore. EBITDA margin contracted to 29.16% from 33.65% in the corresponding period last year due to higher operating costs. The board approved the conversion of remaining 56 lakh warrants in Baazar Style Retail, costing ~₹137.87 crore, to deepen retail penetration. A new exclusive partnership with V2 Retail secures 400 sq. ft. per store across 425+ locations, targeting ₹400 crore in revenue over 12 months. FY27 revenue guidance was raised to ₹880 crore+ (up 47% from original estimates), supported by the upcoming Palava capacity expansion
